description.en:
Sends a character to a position, optionally facing a given direction at the end.
The target is an array [x, y, z] or [x, y, z, rotY] (rotY in degrees). Without rotY the character ends facing the way it walked.
With a speed, the character plays a motion while it moves: up to 0.7 the walk motion 歩き前NN, above that the run motion 走り前NN. ie4_ev_main.nut gives EV_MINI_CHARA_MOVE_SPEED_WALK = 0.3 and EV_MINI_CHARA_MOVE_SPEED_RUN = 1.0. NN is the motion number (last argument, default 1).
The scripts use two shapes: (target, 999, 0, speed[, NN]) for a walk or run, and (target, frames, 0) with no speed, frames from 1 to 200, for a plain slide over that time.
Wait for the end with CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_IS_MOVING.
Character moves and turns are run by a movement manager with 16 slots, one per character. CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG, CMND_CHR_PATH_SETUP and the CMND_CHR_TURN_* commands take a free slot for the character when it has none.
[x, y, z] or [x, y, z, rotY] (degrees).
Duration value; the scripts pass 999 together with a speed, or a number of frames (1 to 200) without one.
Passed on to the move routine; every shipped call passes 0.
Movement speed: EV_MINI_CHARA_MOVE_SPEED_WALK (0.3) or EV_MINI_CHARA_MOVE_SPEED_RUN (1.0). It also picks the walk or run motion.
Number NN of the walk or run motion (the scripts use 1, 7, 9, 20, 30).

Slot number (0 to 15) of the character in the movement manager.
null if all 16 slots are taken, the script system is not ready, or too few arguments are given.

examples.case: Walking to a spot while the screen fades in, then waiting (real usage, from ev42010600.nut)
Running, facing the direction of travel (invented)
examples.code:
// No rotY: the character ends facing the way it ran
CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG(hTenmaL, [10.0, 0.0, -40.0], 999, 0, EV_MINI_CHARA_MOVE_SPEED_RUN);
